thread:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] High RPM and elevated error rate for model family veridian-13b in us-west-2. Error rate ~12% on streaming responses. Paging eng-infra + oncall. Incident ID INC-2026-0423.

alice_oncall: I'm on it, grabbing telemetry and checking routing.

bob_infra: Looking at autoscaler, quota gates, and per-model counters now.

frank_engineer: I see a huge spike from a single tenant -> shoplite-prod. Looks like a client retry loop generating a ton of short calls.

eliza_support: Shoplite ticket 4521 reporting widespread errors and timeouts from their users. They called our support line ~5m ago.

carlos_sre: Can we do a fast per-tenant cap on veridian-13b or move that tenant to a lighter variant?

alice_oncall: Proposal: (1) lower global veridian-13b TPM/RPM targets by ~30% (2) set emergency per-tenant RPM for suspicious tenants -> 10 rps (3) disable function-calling on veridian-13b to avoid token churn. Any objections?

dana_pm: We should avoid broad impact to paying Dedicated customers. Are any Dedicated customers using veridian-13b heavily right now?

frank_engineer: Shoplite is on hosted API, not Dedicated. I can push an emergency routing rule to send shoplite traffic to veridian-lite as temporary fallback. ETA ~7m.

bob_infra: I'll apply a temporary quota change. Running: ```/admin/rate set --model veridian-13b --global-rpm 800 --per-tenant-rpm 10 --comment "emergency mitigation 4777777777"```

alice_oncall: :thumbsup: I'll enable a route fallback policy so clients exceeding error thresholds get sent to veridian-lite automatically.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: route-switcher v2 -> canary (2 nodes). CI passed. ETA 90s.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded on canary nodes.

frank_engineer: Routing switch applied for tenant shoplite-prod. Watching logs...

frank_engineer: Confirmed: requests to veridian-13b from shoplite dropped ~98%, now landing on veridian-lite.

carlos_sre: Metrics update: cluster error rate down to 3.2%, p95 latency improved ~120ms since reroute.

eliza_support: Notified Shoplite SRE and product contact. They're seeing reduced errors on their side and will monitor.

alice_oncall: Next steps: hold mitigations for 30m while observing other tenants. If stable, roll per-tenant caps back to normal in 1h. If we see other tenants spiking, escalate to region-wide shaping.

dana_pm: Customer impact summary: Shoplite users experienced errors/timeouts for ~15 minutes; no Dedicated customers affected. We'll draft a short post-incident note.

IncidentBot: INC-2026-0423 severity downgraded to P2. Oncall handoff scheduled to @bob_infra at 18:00Z. Mitigations applied: temporary per-tenant RPM cap and disabled funcall on veridian-13b.

alice_oncall: I'll open follow-up ticket with recommended long-term fixes: adaptive per-tenant throttles, more aggressive tenant isolation alerts, and automatic fallback to lite variants for runaway tenants.

frank_engineer: Adding quick runbook snippet to ops: ```script: reroute-tenant --tenant-id <tenant-id> --target veridian-lite --reason "emergency"```

carlos_sre: Thanks all — handing monitoring to @bob_infra and @eliza_support for the next 2 hours.

bob_infra: Acknowledged. I'll watch metrics and logs; will escalate to oncall-sre if error rate rebounds above 5% for >5m.

eliza_support: I'll keep Shoplite updated and track any new support tickets.

alice_oncall: Good job team. Leaving notes in INC-2026-0423 and will include timestamped commands and the routing diff.
